cohort: 90 patients scheduled for elective Cesarean section
finding: Epidural administration of 2% mepivacaine 20 minutes after spinal anesthesia does not reduce the incidence of IONV in CS under CSEA, but it does improve intraoperative pain.
mod_finding: Epidural administration of 2% mepivacaine 20 minutes after spinal anesthesia does not reduce the incidence of IONV in CS under CSEA, but it does improve intraoperative pain.
